country_decisions: country.exec.cabinet: Cabinet paper types and review paths, which matters need legal, fiscal, human-rights or other impact review, confidentiality classifications and publication rules, who may sponsor papers and approve the agenda, and the Cabinet rules (members, quorum, decision rule) adopted through policy-change.ts (none ship).
country.exec.records: retention, confidentiality, disclosure and access restrictions for executive-office and Cabinet records (records owner and legal and privacy reviewers).

library.title: Record controlled distribution of a decision
library.intro: Record who a Cabinet decision is distributed to and whether it is published or withheld, with the reasons under the nation's disclosure rules.
library.authority: The office the nation names for the cabinetOffice slot under Who is responsible (authorityFor('cabinetOffice')); where the head of state's office keeps its own correspondence, the nation names that office; never a ministry by name, and holding an office grants no power.

policies.access.read_rule: cabinetReadScope() in lib/auth/roles.ts: officials of the office that keeps the record; a restricted case only to its assignee and signatories; every read of personal data in the access log
policies.access.others: No other institution reads these records; a referral or an assigned action carries only what its own record names

deviations.what: Quorum, the decision rule and the number of members come from the Cabinet rules the nation adopts through policy-change.ts (a part of the constitutional profile, none ships); a production installation records no decision without them
deviations.why: Who decides in Cabinet and by what vote is the nation's constitutional configuration.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Constitutional architecture: country rule sets change only through lib/law/policy-change.ts; nothing ships for a nation

deviations.what: The official who records it comes from the signed-in session, never typed; their authority is the power the procedure step needs and the role roles.ts gives them
deviations.why: Who acted is the verified signed-in official.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Who acted: withOfficial() replaces any name in the request

deviations.what: No threshold, approval tier or limit, payment calendar, fiscal period, variance threshold, forecast horizon, quorum or deadline is typed: each is a named nation value (an approved rule in lib/law/rules.ts or a country rule set) checked by a binding rule, recorded as not performed and a publication blocker until the nation approves it; categories, purposes, outcomes and types the law decides are nation lists that ship empty
deviations.why: The field series Part 2: fiscal calendars, official values, budget authority and statutory deadlines are configured by each nation and approved by its authorized officials.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Government operating model: rates, bands and tariffs come only from lib/law/rules.ts; never type a statutory rate, penalty or deadline into code or seed data

deviations.what: Changing a country configuration does not generate an impact assessment of the forms and open procedure packages it touches: the publication gates re-read the rules and lists in force each time they run, and a procedure version keeps what it was approved with until a new version is approved
deviations.why: No impact-assessment record exists on the platform yet (integration register 20.11).
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Integration register: a stand-in is listed with what connecting it for real takes

deviations.what: The seven minimisation answers per field (Part 1 §1.6) are not in the library contract: they are given with the procedure package the nation approves and recorded in the data and privacy review (a human publication gate)
deviations.why: Question 2 (the provision that authorises collection) is the nation's law; a library draft cannot answer it. No form is approved without the review.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md forms: publication is lib/forms/publication.ts (human approvals by different signed-in officials)

deviations.what: Each evidence item names its kind and when it is needed; the civicos.evidence-requirement.v1 record that ties it to a provision of law is made with the nation's procedure package
deviations.why: The legal basis of evidence is the nation's; until it is cited the evidence gate does not pass.

deviations.what: Scanning, OCR, USSD/SMS and offline field capture are not on the platform: a paper form is transcribed by an official and the case records that it came on paper and who transcribed it

quotes: Record controlled distribution of a decision

platform.how: distribute() and setDisclosure(): every distribution recorded and audited

quotes: These are related but distinct functions.
A country may combine them or place them in separate institutions.
CivicOS must preserve the actual legal structure configured by the country rather than assuming a universal hierarchy.

platform.how: The office keeping Cabinet records is the institution the nation names for the cabinetOffice slot; the Prime Minister's office and the Cabinet office may be one institution or two, as configured

quotes: Required procedure controls: a Cabinet decision is not the same as a statute, budget appropriation, executive order or administrative instruction.
CivicOS must record its actual legal category, the authority of the decision-maker and the actions the decision lawfully authorizes.
An assigned action must not override another institution's independence or exceed its statutory powers.

platform.how: The decision records its legal category, the law cited and the actions it authorises; an action to an independent institution becomes a request, never an instruction (directiveTargetRefusal())
